usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/sound-generation with JSON body {text} (optional: duration_seconds, loop, prompt_influence, model_id; optional query ?output_format=)
usage.outputShape: Response body IS the raw audio file (Content-Type: audio/mpeg). No JSON wrapper — write the bytes directly to a .mp3 file.
quirks: Response is raw binary MP3 audio (audio/mpeg), NOT JSON — save the body bytes directly to a .mp3 file.
Only 'text' is required; other body fields (loop, duration_seconds, prompt_influence, model_id) are optional.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/sound-generation over x402 (pays ~$0.15 USDC on Base) with a JSON body containing at minimum {"text": "<description of the sound>"}. Optionally set duration_seconds (min 0.5), loop, prompt_influence, or model_id, and an output_format query param. The response is the raw audio file itself (Content-Type audio/mpeg) — do not parse it as JSON; write the response bytes straight to a .mp3 file. Plain synchronous call, no auth beyond the x402 payment.
